decisions.decision: Dwyer will contact the Town Manager to ask what the plan is for the Select Board funds for the Old Primary School.
decisions.quote: dwyer will contact the town manager and ask what the plan is to utilize those funds.

decisions.decision: McGrath will assemble the responses from the Mass Historic forum, and the committee will prepare an educational presentation on re-use of buildings like the Old Primary School.
decisions.quote: mcgrath will assemble the responses and the committee will prepare an educational presentation on the possible re-use of buildings like the old primary school

decisions.decision: The APDC will advise the Planning Board to subdivide the Brooks House property and sell the house in place, without deed restrictions, for use as a dwelling or mixed-use building.
decisions.quote: apdc will advise the planning board to subdivide the property and sell the house in place, without deed restrictions, for use as a dwelling or mixed-use building.

decisions.decision: McGrath will approach the board of library trustees about ceding a parking space from their lot for use at the Brooks House.
decisions.quote: mcgrath will approach the board of library trustees to see if they would be willing to cede

decisions.decision: Jack Rodriquenz will order the new APDC signs and install them in the spring.
decisions.quote: mcgrath got the design of the new signs to jack rodriquenz, who will order them and install them in the spring.

decisions.decision: Dwyer will look through his old files for a list of contributing properties to serve as a check-list for the bi-annual inspection of the APD.
